title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 106
description: Ten questions on Psalms 106: Israel's rebellions at the Red Sea, in the desert, at Horeb, at Baal Peor and at Meribah, and God's mercy.

questions.text: Who are called blessed near the start of the psalm?
questions.explanation: Psalms 106:3 says: blessed are those who keep justice; blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

questions.text: Where were the fathers rebellious, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: Psalms 106:7 says the fathers didn't understand his wonders in Egypt and were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

questions.text: God gave the people their request in the desert, but what did he send into their soul?
questions.explanation: Psalms 106:15 says he gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

questions.text: Whom did the earth open and swallow up?
questions.explanation: Psalms 106:17 says the earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

questions.text: Where did the people make a calf and worship a molten image?
questions.explanation: Psalms 106:19 says they made a calf in Horeb and worshiped a molten image.

questions.text: Who stood before God in the breach to turn away his wrath?
questions.explanation: Psalms 106:23 says God would have destroyed them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach to turn away his wrath.

questions.text: Who stood up and executed judgment, so that the plague was stopped?
questions.explanation: Psalms 106:30 says Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.

questions.text: At which waters did they anger God, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes?
questions.explanation: Psalms 106:32 says they angered him at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes.

questions.text: To whom did they sacrifice their sons and their daughters?
questions.explanation: Psalms 106:37 says they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

questions.text: What are all the people told to say at the end of the psalm?
questions.explanation: Psalms 106:48 says: let all the people say, "Amen." Praise Yah!
